The <b>{{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> (formerly known as the <b>wood stockpile</b>) is a construct used to store [[log]]s. It's required in order to later process these logs at a [[sawhorse]] or [[circular saw]]. It does not have any particular function of its own outside of this.

== Note ==
*Only 9 logs can be stored in a stockpile at a time.
*This stockpile pointedly cannot be built at the [[Cabin in the woods]].
**This prevents any wood from being processed at that site.
*Its original footprint is 6x5, noticeable when first starting out.
**There is no apparent advantage in removing it and rebuilding it.
